“Save as a new goal” starts counting Ko-fi payments from now (use it when you start raising for something new). “Save goal” keeps the current count.

Ko-fi connection

  1. On Ko-fi, go to Settings → More → API.
  2. Paste this as the Webhook URL:
  3. Copy the Verification Token from that page into a Cloudflare secret named KOFI_VERIFICATION_TOKEN (Pages project → Settings → Variables and Secrets), then redeploy.
  4. Use Ko-fi’s “Send Test” button. “Last payment received” above should update.

The site only keeps each payment’s amount, type and time. Names, emails and messages are never stored.
